lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਮਨਿ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: bin satigur kinai na paaio kar vekhahu man veechaar ||
lines.translation: Without the True Guru, no one has found Him; reflect upon this in your mind and see.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜਿਚਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਨ ਕਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh mail na utarai jichar gur sabad na kare piaar ||1||
lines.translation: The filth of the self-willed manmukhs is not washed off; they have no love for the Guru's Shabad. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mere satigur kai bhaanai chal ||
lines.translation: O my mind, walk in harmony with the True Guru.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਹਿ ਤਾ ਸੁਖ ਲਹਹਿ ਮਹਲੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: nij ghar vasahi a(n)mrit peevahi taa sukh lahahi mahal ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Dwell within the home of your own inner being, and drink in the Ambrosial Nectar; you shall attain the Peace of the Mansion of His Presence. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਅਉਗੁਣਵੰਤੀ ਗੁਣੁ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ ਬਹਣਿ ਨ ਮਿਲੈ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: augunava(n)tee gun ko nahee bahan na milai hadoor ||
lines.translation: The unvirtuous have no merit; they are not allowed to sit in His Presence.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਅਵਗਣਿ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: manamukh sabad na jaanaee avagan so prabh door ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs do not know the Shabad; those without virtue are far removed from God.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਭਰਪੂਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinee sach pachhaaniaa sach rate bharapoor ||
lines.translation: Those who recognize the True One are permeated and attuned to Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਆਪਿ ਹਦੂਰਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: gurasabadee man bedhiaa prabh miliaa aap hadoor ||2||
lines.translation: Their minds are pierced through by the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and God Himself ushers them into His Presence. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਰੰਗਣਿ ਰੰਗਿਓਨੁ ਸਬਦੇ ਲਇਓਨੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape ra(n)gan ra(n)gion sabade laion milaai ||
lines.translation: He Himself dyes us in the Color of His Love; through the Word of His Shabad, He unites us with Himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਨ ਉਤਰੈ ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sachaa ra(n)g na utarai jo sach rate liv laai ||
lines.translation: This True Color shall not fade away, for those who are attuned to His Love.

lines.gurmukhi: ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਡਾ ਭਵਿ ਥਕੇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੂਝ ਨ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: chaare ku(n)daa bhav thake manamukh boojh na paai ||
lines.translation: The self-willed manmukhs grow weary of wandering around in all four directions, but they do not understand.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਸੋ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jis satigur mele so milai sachai sabad samaai ||3||
lines.translation: One who is united with the True Guru, meets and merges in the True Word of the Shabad. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਤ੍ਰ ਘਣੇਰੇ ਕਰਿ ਥਕੀ ਮੇਰਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਾਟੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mitr ghanere kar thakee meraa dukh kaatai koi ||
lines.translation: I have grown weary of making so many friends, hoping that someone might be able to end my suffering.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਿਲਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਦੁਖੁ ਕਟਿਆ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mil preetam dukh katiaa sabad milaavaa hoi ||
lines.translation: Meeting with my Beloved, my suffering has ended; I have attained Union with the Word of the Shabad.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਖਟਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਰਾਸਿ ਹੈ ਸਚੇ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach khatanaa sach raas hai sache sachee soi ||
lines.translation: Earning Truth, and accumulating the Wealth of Truth, the truthful person gains a reputation of Truth.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਸੇ ਨ ਵਿਛੁੜਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥੨੬॥੫੯॥
lines.transliteration: sach mile se na vichhuRahi naanak guramukh hoi ||4||26||59||
lines.translation: Meeting with the True One, O Nanak, the Gurmukh shall not be separated from Him again. ||4||26||59||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਦੇਖੈ ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape kaaran karataa kare srisat dekhai aap upaai ||
lines.translation: The Creator Himself created the Creation; He produced the Universe, and He Himself watches over it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਏਕੋ ਇਕੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਅਲਖੁ ਨ ਲਖਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh eko ik varatadaa alakh na lakhiaa jaai ||
lines.translation: The One and Only Lord is pervading and permeating all. The Unseen cannot be seen.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਦੇਇ ਬੁਝਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape prabhoo daiaal hai aape dei bujhaai ||
lines.translation: God Himself is Merciful; He Himself bestows understanding.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਦ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: guramatee sad man vasiaa sach rahe liv laai ||1||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, the True One dwells forever in the mind of those who remain lovingly attached to Him. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮੰਨਿ ਲੈ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mere gur kee ma(n)n lai rajaai ||
lines.translation: O my mind, surrender to the Guru's Will.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਸਭੁ ਥੀਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: man tan seetal sabh theeai naam vasai man aai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Mind and body are totally cooled and soothed, and the Naam comes to dwell in the mind. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨਿ ਕਰਿ ਕਾਰਣੁ ਧਾਰਿਆ ਸੋਈ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jin kar kaaran dhaariaa soee saar karei ||
lines.translation: Having created the creation, He supports it and takes care of it.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur kai sabad pachhaaneeai jaa aape nadar karei ||
lines.translation: The Word of the Guru's Shabad is realized, when He Himself bestows His Glance of Grace.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਬਦੇ ਸੋਹਣੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: se jan sabade sohane tit sachai darabaar ||
lines.translation: Those who are beautifully adorned with the Shabad in the Court of the True Lord

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਆਪਿ ਮੇਲੇ ਕਰਤਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: guramukh sachai sabad rate aap mele karataar ||2||
lines.translation: -those Gurmukhs are attuned to the True Word of the Shabad; the Creator unites them with Himself. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹਣਾ ਜਿਸ ਦਾ ਅੰਤੁ ਨ ਪਾਰਾਵਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramatee sach salaahanaa jis daa a(n)t na paaraavaar ||
lines.translation: Through the Guru's Teachings, praise the True One, who has no end or limitation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਵਸੈ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਕਰੇ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
lines.transliteration: ghat ghat aape hukam vasai hukame kare beechaar ||
lines.translation: He dwells in each and every heart, by the Hukam of His Command; by His Hukam, we contemplate Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਸਬਦੀ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਖੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gurasabadee saalaaheeai haumai vichahu khoi ||
lines.translation: So praise Him through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, and drive out egotism from within.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਾ ਧਨ ਨਾਵੈ ਬਾਹਰੀ ਅਵਗਣਵੰਤੀ ਰੋਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: saa dhan naavai baaharee avaganava(n)tee roi ||3||
lines.translation: That soul-bride who lacks the Lord's Name acts without virtue, and so she grieves. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਚੁ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਸਚਿ ਲਗਾ ਸਚੈ ਨਾਇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sach salaahee sach lagaa sachai naai tripat hoi ||
lines.translation: Praising the True One, attached to the True One, I am satisfied with the True Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਣ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਗੁਣ ਸੰਗ੍ਰਹਾ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਕਢਾ ਧੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: gun veechaaree gun sa(n)grahaa avagun kadhaa dhoi ||
lines.translation: Contemplating His Virtues, I accumulate virtue and merit; I wash myself clean of demerits.

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਦਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਵੇਛੋੜਾ ਨ ਹੋਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aape mel milaaidaa phir vechhoRaa na hoi ||
lines.translation: He Himself unites us in His Union; there is no more separation.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਆਪਣਾ ਜਿਦੂ ਪਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੪॥੨੭॥੬੦॥
lines.transliteration: naanak gur saalaahee aapanaa jidoo paaee prabh soi ||4||27||60||
lines.translation: O Nanak, I sing the Praises of my Guru; through Him, I find that God. ||4||27||60||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਿਰੀਰਾਗੁ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
lines.transliteration: sireeraag mahalaa 3 ||
lines.translation: Siree Raag, Third Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਕਾਮ ਗਹੇਲੀਏ ਕਿਆ ਚਲਹਿ ਬਾਹ ਲੁਡਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun sun kaam gaheleee kiaa chalahi baah ludaai ||
lines.translation: Listen, listen, O soul-bride: you are overtaken by sexual desire-why do you walk like that, swinging your arms in joy?

lines.gurmukhi: ਆਪਣਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਨ ਪਛਾਣਹੀ ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸਹਿ ਜਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: aapanaa pir na pachhaanahee kiaa muhu desahi jaai ||
lines.translation: You do not recognize your own Husband Lord! When you go to Him, what face will you show Him?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਿਨੀ ਸਖਂੀ ਕੰਤੁ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਲਾਗਉ ਪਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: jinee sakha(n)ee ka(n)t pachhaaniaa hau tin kai laagau paai ||
lines.translation: I touch the feet of my sister soul-brides who have known their Husband Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਜੈਸੀ ਥੀ ਰਹਾ ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tin hee jaisee thee rahaa satasa(n)gat mel milaai ||1||
lines.translation: If only I could be like them! Joining the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, I am united in His Union. ||1||
